# Linkbot

> Find work. Find talent. Keep your privacy. Linkbot shows people current job listings with the
> evidence for every claim, and gives recruiting agencies and companies one place to describe a
> role and work from evidence. There is no public profile and no index of people.

## What this site is

The official site for Linkbot. Two things are offered:

- Find work: search current public job listings in your own words. Each listing shows what it
  states, what it states differently, and what it does not say. No account is needed to search;
  searches are not stored. Saving a job or watching a search needs an account. Nothing is shared
  with an employer unless the person confirms it.
- Find talent: recruiting agencies work their own candidate pool against client mandates with an
  explainable, evidence-backed shortlist; companies describe their own roles and receive the
  applications people deliberately send. Access is granted to verified organisations during the
  pilot. Linkbot sends no messages on anyone's behalf.

## Who operates it

Linkbot OÜ, registered in Tallinn, Estonia.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://linkbot.org/): what Linkbot does for people, for recruiting agencies and for companies.

## Canonical URL

- https://linkbot.org/

## What this site is not

- It is not a recruiter database and holds no index of people.
- It is not a public profile host.
- It is not a job board: listings are searched in the product, not published on this site.
